description: The Weaver's health answer (WEAVER.md § Health). `status` is `ok` whenever the Weaver answers: it says nothing of whether the Weaver can reach the gateway or the graph.

kb.description: The DID of the knowledge base it serves: the one its settings name, which that knowledge base said it is before the Weaver connected to the graph database.

reconcile.description: How far the reconcile its first sweep is followed by has got (WEAVER.md § Reconcile): the pass's `summary` when it is done, or its `error` when it failed.

summary.description: What the pass found and did.

divergent.description: How many of them were divergent: the graph held them otherwise than the record.

healed.description: How many divergent resources it rebuilt.

healFailures.description: How many it did not heal, because the rebuild stopped at an event it could not apply.

orphaned.description: How many orphaned views it found: resources the catalog lists and the record holds no events for. Each is counted, and not healed.
